entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for an order I placed.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF-98765. It's for the VeloBand Pulse. It just doesn't track my heart rate correctly during my rides.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF-98765... I see the VeloBand Pulse here. And it looks like it was delivered to you 14 days ago, is that correct?
I guess? So what? I want to return it.
I understand. Sir, I'm seeing here in our policy that the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window from the date of delivery.
Are you serious? Ten days? That's insane. I had a busy week. So you're telling me I'm stuck with a faulty product because I'm four days late?
I do apologize for the inconvenience. The policy is in place for electronic health devices, but I understand your frustration completely. You're right, it's only four days.
This is ridiculous. I want to speak to your supervisor. This is a terrible way to do business.
Please, just give me one moment. Look... I'm not supposed to do this, and I can get in a lot of trouble for it. But as a **one-time exception**, let me see what I can do.
What do you mean?
I'm going to try and **override the system** for you. Honestly, my **manager would kill me** if she saw me do this, but I think we can make this right for you. Can you hold for just 30 seconds?
Uh... okay. Yeah, fine.

Okay... processing... and... there. It worked. I've successfully processed the return authorization. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack it up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we get it back, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
Wow. I... I didn't think you'd actually be able to do that. Thank you so much. I was getting really frustrated.
It's no problem at all. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. We want you to be happy with your VeloFit experience, even if this particular product wasn't the right fit.
Well, you definitely helped. I really appreciate it, Sam. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
